strongest_verified_claim: Every connected surface with finitely many n>=3 ambient ends has a connected nondisplaceable compact subsurface. For an infinite-genus translation/Riemann surface this forces the full rotational affine preimage, and consequently Gamma(S) intersect SO(2), to be finite. Therefore the exact pair X={0,2/3,1}, G=<(1/5)[[3,-4],[4,3]]> is impossible, even as an inclusion of G in Gamma(S), under the submitted underlying-surface convention.
